column1: # SLH-DSA shim parameters. Columns: file, name, pk, sk, sig, iters, param
# param: slh_dsa.h parameter struct variable name
# iters: 50 for the FIPS 205 variants. The SP 800-230 ipd *-24 variants (2^24 signatures
# per key; d = 1, so keygen and every signature rebuild one 2^21-2^22-leaf XMSS tree, and
# slhdsa-c caches nothing) take about 10 min per keygen and per signature on an
# i7-8550U: iters 1. Only the SHAKE ones are built (the site lists SHAKE only). They exceed
# the default time limits (BENCH_OP_LIMIT 600 s per signature, BENCH_TIMEOUT 3600 s) and are
# exempt from them (Thom, 2026-10-14) via scripts/aws-bench-exemptions.txt: scripts/aws-bench-split
# runs each alone with BENCH_OP_LIMIT=0 BENCH_TIMEOUT=0. A plain run_bench.sh run still DNFs them.
